subject: ONE plump emperor penguin in a red knitted scarf, two identical green banknotes tucked in his belly fold
second_characters: TWO bald vultures swooping for coins, ONE camel chewing a palm frond
props: ONE chrome currency machine: banknote slot, coin chute, blue screen; gold coins
environment: a desert oasis at blazing noon on flat sand: tall palms swaying hard, wind-rippled dunes, sand streaming off their crests, tumbleweeds rolling, heat shimmer, no empty ground
lighting: blazing overhead sun, high exposure, glints on chrome and coins

light_events.event: a sun flare blazes off the chrome as the scarf vanishes into the slot

motion_rule: the penguin fills two thirds of the TALL frame, face never under a quarter, except the three close-ups where a coin or his face fills the frame. Never still: hopping, flippers flapping, belly bouncing. Something crosses the lens EVERY beat, speech beats too; in close-ups things come INTO the lens. The camera sways close, never parks, new shot size every beat. ONE big action per beat.

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word
audio.pacing: first word right on the slap at 0.4; no words 1.88-6.50; each line once, last word by 9.0
audio.lip_sync: the penguin himself speaks, beak opening on every syllable, brows and jaw alive
audio.pronunciation: PER-va-ya ob-me-NYA-las. fta-RA-ya, VI-di-mo, na-SHLA svoy KURS v MI-nus
audio.sfx: coins clattering, desert wind, camel grunt, vultures

timeline.a: he slaps the first green banknote into the slot, a tumbleweed bouncing across the lens
chest-up, facing the lens, beak working, he holds out his belly fold and hops up into the coins gushing from the chute, sand streaming across the lens
hopping off the scorching sand, he slaps the identical second green banknote in, a frond whipping across the lens
close-up: the screen flashes red, he is yanked to the machine, one coin rips from his belly fold into the lens, filling the frame, the rest stream up the chute
the slot snags his scarf end, a vulture yanks it, he spins as it unwinds off his neck
he heaves the scarf back, leaning back, feet ploughing sand, a tumbleweed across the lens
the camera hurls itself from far to his neck, background rushing: the scarf zips into the slot, neck bare, he shakes out every feather, sand spraying across the lens
the machine spits ONE tiny coin that bounces off his head onto the sand, he jumps and slaps his crown, both vultures swooping across the lens
waist-up, facing the lens, beak working, he yanks his empty belly fold inside out, the camel's chewing head swinging across the lens below his beak
close-up: beak working, he snatches the tiny coin from under a vulture's beak and thrusts eye and coin INTO the lens, filling the frame, palms whipping behind
close-up: he thrusts his face into the lens, filling the frame, flat stare, blinks once, bare neck, sand streaming off a dune behind

must_appear: palms; 2.58 red screen; 4.78 bare neck; 7.75 coin at his eye; 9.00 flat stare
negative_prompt: text, digits, subtitles, a horizontal 16:9 picture, a hero running at the camera, zoom, wide shot, a closed beak while speaking, offscreen narration, a line said twice, a repeated or stuttered word, speech after 9.0, English speech, foreign accent, a third banknote, duplicate props, floating objects, seagulls, a dune climb
